name: Solar Array
clause: {T}: Add one mana of any color. When you next cast an artifact spell this turn, that spell gains sunburst.

needs.proposedSignature: AsEnters { kind: 'sunburst' } (charge counters on a noncreature, +1/+1 counters on a creature, one per colour of mana spent) plus { op: 'grant-keyword-to-spell', target: TargetSpec | Ref, keywords: Keyword[] } and a delayed-trigger point 'next-cast-this-turn' with a filter
needs.semantics: CR 702.44. The enters-with half is already expressible as counters with { count: 'colors-spent' }, but nothing can GRANT sunburst to a spell on the stack (grant-keyword acts on permanents) and there is no 'when you next cast a <filter> spell this turn' firing point.
needs.clause: Whenever you cast an artifact creature spell, it gains sunburst.
